description: The BTPS 1.2 template file, formats 1 and 2 (Templates page; JSON Schema at docs/docusaurus/static/schemas/btps-template.schema.json, published with the docs site as schemas/btps-template.schema.json). A template says how a document looks, never what it says: it never carries or changes a value of the document, hides no section with signed fields, names nothing to fetch and runs nothing; its own words are labels from a fixed set and static terms and footer text, each plain words with no digit run of four or more and no web, email or BTPS address. Format 1 is for invoices and receipts. Format 2 is format 1 for them, plus payslips (sections and labels of their own) and letters (the page, a letterhead placing every one of the sender's own fields, and a footer with a sign-off and signature slots, whose values come from the document; never the body). An implementation accepts every "accept" template and refuses every "refuse" one; `check` is the rule that refuses it: "schema" for the JSON Schema, "contrast" for the WCAG AA contrast of `page.text` and `page.muted` (4.5:1) and `page.accent` (3:1) against `page.background`. `fingerprint` is a template's RFC 8785 canonical form and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of it, which `template.data.sha256` names.
